entities.name: Graph Communities
entities.description: A hierarchy providing community partitions that cover graph nodes in a mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive way.
entities.evidence: Each level of this hierarchy provides a community partition that covers the nodes of the graph in a mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive way

entities.name: Community Summaries
entities.description: Report-like summaries of each community in the community hierarchy used for global summarization and answering queries.
entities.evidence: The next step creates report-like summaries of each community in the community hierarchy, using a method designed to scale to very large datasets

entities.name: Community Answers
entities.description: Intermediate answers generated in parallel to address specific questions before reduction to a global answer.
entities.evidence: Given a user query, the community summaries generated in the previous step can be used to generate a final answer in a multi-stage process

entities.name: Global Answer
entities.description: The final answer returned to the user after sorting and combining intermediate community answers.
entities.evidence: This final context is used to generate the global answer returned to the user

entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A system that generates community summaries by adding element summaries to a community summary template.
entities.evidence: GraphRAG generates community summaries by adding various element summaries (for nodes, edges, and related claims) to a community summary template

entities.name: LLM
entities.description: A model used to generate community summaries, scores, and global answers within the system.
entities.evidence: The LLM is also asked to generate a score between 0-100 indicating how helpful the generated answer is in answering the target question

entities.name: Global Sensemaking Question Generation
entities.description: A process using an LLM to generate corpus-specific questions designed to assess high-level understanding without retrieving specific low-level facts.
entities.evidence: To evaluate the effectiveness of RAG systems for global sensemaking tasks, we use an LLM to generate a set of corpus-specific questions designed to asses high-level understanding of a given corpus

entities.name: Leaf-level communities
entities.description: The lowest level of the community hierarchy where element summaries are prioritized and added to the context window.
entities.evidence: Leaf-level communities. The element summaries of a leaf-level community are prioritized and then iteratively added to the LLM context window until the token limit is reached

entities.name: Higher-level communities
entities.description: Communities above the leaf level where sub-community summaries are substituted for element summaries if token limits are reached.
entities.evidence: Higher-level communities. If all element summaries fit within the token limit of the context window, proceed as for leaf-level communities and summarize all element summaries within the community

entities.name: Token limit
entities.description: A constraint on the context window size that determines when element summaries must be replaced by sub-community summaries.
entities.evidence: until the token limit is reached
